Container.Name: FrameGallery
Container.Overview: Local picture library for the Samsung The Frame in the living room. Originals, fitted 3840x2160 JPEGs, thumbnails and one SQLite file live under /data; the gallery never reads anything from the TV. The TV is contacted only when someone presses a button, one short attempt each time: no Wake-on-LAN, no polling, no retries. Build the image from the repository (docker build -t frame-gallery:local .) before adding this template.
Container.Requires: The first TV action shows an Allow prompt on the TV for "Frame Gallery" if the TV asks for one; the token, if any, is kept in /data/tv-token.

Config.Name: TV address
Config.Description: The Frame on the LAN (TV: Settings › General › Network › Network Status). Contacted only on a button press.

Config.Name: Largest crop
Config.Description: Import centre-crops a picture to 16:9 when that removes at most this share of it, and refuses it otherwise.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: library.db (metadata, collections), originals/, fitted/, thumbs/ and the TV token. Owned by nobody:users (99:100). Appdata Backup picks it up like every other app.
